snippet.title: Closed Alpha Test Date Announcement l NAKWON: LAST PARADISE
snippet.description:
EXIT OR DIE, NAKWON's Closed Alpha Test will take place from March 11th to March 15th (PT). 
There is no single right answer to survival. Do whatever it takes to stay alive and trust no one.
Apply for the playtest and join NAKWON as a Survivor. For more updates, follow our official community channels, and don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam.

============================================================
✔️ Wishlist on Steam : https://nexon.link/bjc
✔️ Official Website: https://nakwon.nexon.com/en/teaser
✔️ Official Discord : https://discord.com/invite/nakwon
============================================================
#NAKWON #trailer #zombie #survival
